title: India's World Championships Medal History Reviewed
indian_angle: This feature provides a comprehensive look at India's past successes at the BWF World Championships, including recent bronze medallists Satwik-Chirag, ahead of the 2026 event.
summary: Ahead of the BWF World Championships 2026, a detailed list of all Indian medallists from Prakash Padukone's 1983 bronze to Satwik-Chirag's 2025 bronze has been published, highlighting the nation's achievements.

summary: The National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is hosting a coaching camp for the Indian team preparing for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Domestic Junior Events
indian_angle: This significant rule change to the 3x15 scoring system will impact all U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.

title: Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Tournament in Chennai

summary: The Yonex-Sunrise All India Senior Ranking Badminton Tournament 2026 is scheduled to take place in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, from July 16th to 23rd, as per a recent BAI circular.
